page_title: NAP 3-1 INT | Napoli v Inter 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Alessandro Buongiorno is replaced by Sam Beukema (Napoli).
90' The referee signals a substitution. Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Leonardo Spinazzola.
87' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
84' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
81' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Matteo Politano and he is replaced by Eljif Elmas (Napoli).
81' David Neres just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Noa Lang (Napoli) replaces him.
79' David Neres (Napoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
77' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
77' Inter are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Denzel Dumfries will be replaced by Luis Henrique (Inter).
73' Here is a change. Nicolo Barella is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Davide Frattesi (Inter).
72' The substitution has been made. Petar Sucic (Inter) has replaced Hakan Calhanoglu.
71' Manuel Akanji (Inter) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.

67' 3 - 1 Goal! Frank Anguissa (Napoli) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the right post. Yann Sommer had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:1.
66' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ange-Yoan Bonny walks off the pitch to be replaced by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
61' Referee Maurizio Mariani halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Antonio Conte, then shows him a yellow.
59' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Vanja Milinkovic-Savic no chance!
59' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
58' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
57' Referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
57' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) touches the ball with his hand.
56' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Maurizio Mariani signals. Napoli are awarded a free kick.
54' 2 - 0 Scott McTominay (Napoli) makes a good run to meet a cross on the edge of the box and with a fantastic shot lashes the ball inside the left post.
52' Scott McTominay (Napoli) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
50' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) is penalised for holding. Maurizio Mariani signals a set piece.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
45+4' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45+2' Chance! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
43' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
43' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) makes a slide tackle, but referee Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Inter, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
41' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sees his header crash off the crossbar after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
41' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take the corner.
38' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a long ball in, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comfortably gathers the ball.
37' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
37' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) is being substituted because of an injury. Antonio Conte sends Mathias Olivera on the pitch.
34' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) picks up an injury.
33' 1 - 0 Goal! Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yann Sommer into left side of the goal.
33' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
33' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
32' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Piotr Zielinski (Inter) is coming onto the pitch as Henrikh Mkhitaryan cannot continue after picking up an injury.
30' Referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
30' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) commits a foul after dangerous play. Napoli are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
28' David Neres (Napoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
26' David Neres (Napoli) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is behind the touchline and Inter will take a throw-in.
24' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
23' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman signals a throw-in for Inter.

21' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
19' Nicolo Barella (Inter) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. Napoli have been awarded a free kick.
17' Matteo Politano (Napoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

15' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
13' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

12' The game is interrupted. Juan Jesus (Napoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Inter win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
10' David Neres (Napoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for an infringement.

9' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
9' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
9' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
5' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
2' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has just begun.
Napoli will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Maurizio Mariani.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
